<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Espartanos Traditio — Marroquinería Artesanal Hecho en España</title>
<meta name="description" content="Cinturones, maletines, mochilas, portadocumentos y tirantes de piel 100% real, hechos a mano en España.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#0f1526;
  --ink-2:#182140;
  --ink-3:#232d52;
  --paper:#f1ece0;
  --paper-2:#e8e0cd;
  --paper-3:#ded4bb;
  --leather:#6b4128;
  --leather-2:#8a5a35;
  --leather-light:#c9a06a;
  --brass:#b08b4f;
  --brass-light:#d8bd85;
  --text:#211b13;
  --muted:#6f6656;
  --muted-2:#a89d86;
  --white:#fffdf8;
  --danger:#a13a2c;
  --ok:#3c6b4a;
  --radius:2px;
  --shadow-soft: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(15,21,38,0.35);
  --shadow-lift: 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(15,21,38,0.5);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
  *{animation-duration:0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.001ms !important;}
}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--paper);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Manrope', sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4{
  font-family:'Fraunces', serif;
  margin:0;
  font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;
}
p{margin:0;}
a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
button{font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer;}
ul{margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;}
.wrap{max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 32px;}
@media (max-width:640px){.wrap{padding:0 18px;}}

/* ---------- signature divider (brand's own arrow/dot mark) ---------- */
.divider{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px;
  color:var(--brass); margin: 28px 0;
}
.divider .ln{width:64px; height:1px; background:var(--brass); position:relative;}
.divider .ln::before,.divider .ln::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; top:-3px; width:7px; height:7px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--brass); border-right:1px solid var(--brass);
}
.divider .ln.l::before{ left:-1px; transform:rotate(-135deg); }
.divider .ln.r::after{ right:-1px; transform:rotate(45deg); }
.divider .dot{width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--brass);}
.divider.dark{color:var(--brass-light);}
.divider.dark .ln{background:var(--brass-light);}
.divider.dark .ln::before,.divider.dark .ln::after{border-color:var(--brass-light);}
.divider.dark .dot{background:var(--brass-light);}

/* ---------- utility bar ---------- */
.utility-bar{
  background:var(--ink); color:var(--muted-2); font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.utility-bar .wrap{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; height:36px;}
.utility-bar a{color:var(--paper-2); transition:color .2s;}
.utility-bar a:hover{color:var(--brass-light);}
.utility-bar .ubar-links{display:flex; gap:22px;}
.utility-bar .ubar-tag{color:var(--brass-light); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px;}
@media(max-width:720px){.utility-bar .ubar-links a:nth-child(2){display:none;}}

/* ---------- header ---------- */
header.site{
  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:60;
  background:rgba(241,236,224,0.92); backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-3);
}
.header-row{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; height:82px; gap:24px;}
.brandmark{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
.brandmark svg{width:38px; height:44px; flex:none;}
.brand-name{display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1;}
.brand-name .wordmark{font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-weight:700; font-size:20px; letter-spacing:.03em;}
.brand-name .subword{font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.22em; color:var(--muted); margin-top:4px; font-weight:600;}
nav.mainnav{display:flex; gap:30px;}
nav.mainnav a{
  font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em; color:var(--text);
  position:relative; padding:6px 0;
}
nav.mainnav a::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; width:0%; height:1.5px; background:var(--leather);
  transition:width .25s ease;
}
nav.mainnav a:hover::after{width:100%;}
.header-actions{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;}
.icon-btn{
  width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid var(--paper-3); background:var(--white);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:relative; transition:border-color .2s, transform .15s;
}
.icon-btn:hover{border-color:var(--leather); transform:translateY(-1px);}
.icon-btn svg{width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--ink);}
.cart-count{
  position:absolute; top:-6px; right:-6px; background:var(--leather); color:var(--white);
  font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; min-width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 3px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
}
.burger{display:none; width:40px; height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--paper-3); border-radius:50%; background:var(--white);}
.burger svg{width:18px; height:18px;}
@media(max-width:920px){
  nav.mainnav{display:none;}
  .burger{display:flex;}
}
.mobile-nav{
  display:none; flex-direction:column; background:var(--white); border-top:1px solid var(--paper-3);
  padding:14px 18px 22px;
}
.mobile-nav.open{display:flex;}
.mobile-nav a{padding:12px 4px; font-weight:600; border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-2); font-size:14.5px;}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{
  position:relative; background:linear-gradient(160deg, var(--ink) 0%, var(--ink-2) 62%, var(--ink-3) 100%);
  color:var(--paper); overflow:hidden;
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 92%, 0 100%);
  padding-bottom:70px;
}
.hero-watermark{
  position:absolute; right:-60px; top:-40px; width:640px; opacity:.07; pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-watermark svg{width:100%; height:auto;}
.hero-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr; gap:50px; align-items:center;
  padding-top:64px;
}
@media(max-width:980px){ .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; padding-top:40px;} }
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.22em;
  color:var(--brass-light); font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:22px;
}
.eyebrow::before{content:""; width:26px; height:1px; background:var(--brass-light);}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(38px, 5vw, 62px); line-height:1.04; color:var(--white); font-weight:700;
}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal; color:var(--brass-light);}
.hero-sub{
  margin-top:22px; font-size:16.5px; line-height:1.65; color:var(--paper-2); max-width:480px;
}
.hero-cta{display:flex; gap:16px; margin-top:36px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
  padding:15px 28px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase;
  border-radius:1px; border:1px solid transparent; transition:transform .18s ease, background .2s, border-color .2s, color .2s;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97);}
.btn-primary{background:var(--leather); color:var(--white);}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--leather-2);}
.btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35); color:var(--white);}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--brass-light); color:var(--brass-light);}
.btn-outline-dark{border-color:var(--ink); color:var(--ink);}
.btn-outline-dark:hover{background:var(--ink); color:var(--white);}
.btn-block{width:100%;}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed;}

.hero-visual{position:relative;}
.hero-frame{
  position:relative; background:var(--paper); border-radius:2px; padding:26px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift); transform:rotate(1.2deg);
}
.hero-frame img{width:100%; border-radius:1px; aspect-ratio:4/3.1; object-fit:cover; object-position:center 30%;}
.hero-frame::before, .hero-frame::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; width:22px; height:22px; border-color:var(--brass); border-style:solid;
}
.hero-frame::before{top:8px; left:8px; border-width:1.5px 0 0 1.5px;}
.hero-frame::after{bottom:8px; right:8px; border-width:0 1.5px 1.5px 0;}
.price-tag{
  position:absolute; bottom:-22px; left:26px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--white);
  padding:12px 18px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft); font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:12px;
  border:1px solid var(--brass);
}
.price-tag .label{color:var(--brass-light); display:block; font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.15em; margin-bottom:3px;}

/* ---------- trust strip ---------- */
.trust{
  background:var(--paper); border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-3);
}
.trust .wrap{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:20px; padding:26px 32px;
}
@media(max-width:780px){ .trust .wrap{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} }
.trust-item{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
.trust-item svg{width:26px; height:26px; stroke:var(--leather); flex:none;}
.trust-item span{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em; line-height:1.3;}

/* ---------- about ---------- */
.about{padding:96px 0; background:var(--paper);}
.about-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr; gap:64px; align-items:center;}
@media(max-width:900px){.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:36px;}}
.about-img{position:relative;}
.about-img img{border-radius:2px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft); aspect-ratio:3/3.6; object-fit:cover;}
.about-tag{
  position:absolute; top:-18px; right:-18px; background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--paper-3);
  padding:14px 18px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft); text-align:center;
}
.about-tag .num{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:22px; font-weight:700; color:var(--leather); display:block;}
.about-tag .cap{font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.14em; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase;}
.section-eyebrow{
  font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--leather); font-weight:800; margin-bottom:14px; display:block;
}
.about h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,40px); line-height:1.12; margin-bottom:22px;}
.about p{color:var(--muted); font-size:15.5px; line-height:1.8; margin-bottom:16px; max-width:560px;}
.about-badges{display:flex; gap:26px; margin-top:28px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.made-badge{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:.02em; color:var(--ink); display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.05;}
.made-badge span{color:var(--leather);}
.leather-badge{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--muted);}
.leather-badge svg{width:20px; height:20px; stroke:var(--leather);}

/* ---------- category chips ---------- */
.catnav{
  position:sticky; top:82px; z-index:40; background:var(--paper-2); border-top:1px solid var(--paper-3); border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-3);
}
.catnav .wrap{display:flex; gap:10px; padding:14px 32px; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none;}
.catnav .wrap::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.chip{
  flex:none; padding:9px 18px; border:1px solid var(--paper-3); border-radius:30px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700;
  background:var(--white); color:var(--text); transition:all .2s;
}
.chip:hover, .chip.active{background:var(--ink); color:var(--white); border-color:var(--ink);}

/* ---------- catalog sections ---------- */
.category-section{padding:86px 0 30px;}
.category-head{max-width:640px; margin-bottom:20px;}
.category-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,36px); margin-bottom:12px;}
.category-head p{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; line-height:1.7;}
.grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px,1fr)); gap:28px; margin-top:36px;
}
.card{
  background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--paper-3); display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease; opacity:0; transform:translateY(18px);
}
.card.in{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft);}
.card-img{
  aspect-ratio:1/1; background:var(--paper-2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; position:relative;
}
.card-img img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .5s ease;}
.card:hover .card-img img{transform:scale(1.055);}
.card-badge{
  position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; background:rgba(15,21,38,0.85); color:var(--brass-light);
  font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.1em; padding:5px 9px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; text-transform:uppercase;
}
.card-body{padding:18px 18px 20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; flex:1;}
.card-name{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.25;}
.card-desc{font-size:12.8px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.55; flex:1;}
.card-meta{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase;}
.card-foot{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-top:6px; padding-top:14px; border-top:1px dashed var(--paper-3);}
.price{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; color:var(--leather);}
.price small{display:block; font-size:9px; color:var(--muted-2); font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;}
.qty-add{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;}
.qty-stepper{display:flex; align-items:center; border:1px solid var(--paper-3);}
.qty-stepper button{width:26px; height:30px; background:none; border:none; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink);}
.qty-stepper button:hover{background:var(--paper-2);}
.qty-stepper span{width:22px; text-align:center; font-size:12.5px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}
.add-btn{
  width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ink); border:none; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  transition:background .2s, transform .15s;
}
.add-btn svg{width:16px; height:16px; stroke:var(--white);}
.add-btn:hover{background:var(--leather);}
.add-btn.added{background:var(--ok);}

/* ---------- cart drawer ---------- */
.overlay{
  position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(15,21,38,0.55); z-index:90; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .3s;
}
.overlay.show{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto;}
.drawer{
  position:fixed; top:0; right:0; height:100%; width:min(420px, 92vw); background:var(--white); z-index:95;
  transform:translateX(100%); transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1); display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  box-shadow:-20px 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
.drawer.show{transform:translateX(0);}
.drawer-head{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:22px 24px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-3);}
.drawer-head h3{font-size:19px;}
.close-btn{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid var(--paper-3); background:none; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;}
.close-btn svg{width:15px; height:15px;}
.drawer-body{flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:10px 24px;}
.empty-cart{padding:60px 10px; text-align:center; color:var(--muted);}
.empty-cart svg{width:48px; height:48px; stroke:var(--muted-2); margin-bottom:16px;}
.cart-item{display:flex; gap:14px; padding:16px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-2);}
.cart-item img{width:66px; height:66px; object-fit:cover; background:var(--paper-2);}
.cart-item-info{flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;}
.cart-item-info .nm{font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px;}
.cart-item-info .pr{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--leather);}
.cart-item-row{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;}
.rm-btn{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2); text-decoration:underline; font-weight:600;}
.rm-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);}
.drawer-foot{padding:20px 24px 26px; border-top:1px solid var(--paper-3);}
.subtotal-row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; margin-bottom:16px;}
.subtotal-row .lbl{font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; color:var(--muted);}
.subtotal-row .val{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:20px; font-weight:600;}
.foot-note{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2); margin-top:12px; text-align:center; line-height:1.5;}

/* ---------- checkout modal ---------- */
.modal-wrap{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:110; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:22px;
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .3s;
}
.modal-wrap.show{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto;}
.modal-box{
  background:var(--white); width:min(600px,100%); max-height:88vh; overflow-y:auto; border-radius:2px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift); transform:translateY(20px) scale(.98); transition:transform .3s;
}
.modal-wrap.show .modal-box{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}
.modal-head{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:24px 28px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-3);}
.modal-head h3{font-size:20px;}
.steps-track{display:flex; gap:6px; padding:0 28px; margin-top:18px;}
.step-dot{flex:1; height:3px; background:var(--paper-3); border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden;}
.step-dot i{display:block; height:100%; width:0%; background:var(--leather); transition:width .3s;}
.modal-body{padding:26px 28px 30px;}
.form-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; margin-bottom:14px;}
.form-row.single{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.field label{display:block; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:7px;}
.field input, .field select, .field textarea{
  width:100%; border:1px solid var(--paper-3); background:var(--paper); padding:12px 13px; font-size:14px; font-family:inherit;
  border-radius:1px; transition:border-color .2s;
}
.field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus{outline:none; border-color:var(--leather);}
.field textarea{resize:vertical; min-height:70px;}
.pay-methods{display:flex; gap:10px; margin-bottom:20px;}
.pay-methods label{
  flex:1; border:1px solid var(--paper-3); padding:12px; text-align:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; transition:all .2s;
}
.pay-methods input{display:none;}
.pay-methods input:checked + span{color:var(--leather);}
.pay-methods label:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--leather); background:#fbf4ea;}
.demo-note{
  background:var(--paper); border:1px dashed var(--brass); padding:12px 14px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted);
  line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:18px;
}
.modal-actions{display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:22px;}
.order-summary{background:var(--paper); padding:16px 18px; margin-bottom:18px; border:1px solid var(--paper-3);}
.order-summary .row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:13px; padding:6px 0;}
.order-summary .row.total{border-top:1px solid var(--paper-3); margin-top:6px; padding-top:12px; font-weight:700; font-size:15px;}
.confirm-view{text-align:center; padding:20px 6px;}
.confirm-icon{width:64px; height:64px; border-radius:50%; background:#e9f2ec; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin:0 auto 20px;}
.confirm-icon svg{width:30px; height:30px; stroke:var(--ok);}
.confirm-view h3{font-size:22px; margin-bottom:10px;}
.confirm-view p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; max-width:400px; margin:0 auto 18px;}
.order-num{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; background:var(--paper); display:inline-block; padding:8px 16px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.05em; margin-bottom:22px; border:1px solid var(--paper-3);}
.spinner{
  width:20px; height:20px; border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4); border-top-color:#fff; border-radius:50%;
  animation:spin .7s linear infinite; display:inline-block;
}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}

/* ---------- footer ---------- */
footer{background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper-2); padding:80px 0 0; margin-top:70px;}
.footer-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr 1.1fr; gap:40px; padding-bottom:56px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
@media(max-width:900px){.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; row-gap:40px;}}
@media(max-width:560px){.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.footer-brand .brandmark{margin-bottom:16px;}
.footer-brand .brand-name .wordmark{color:var(--white);}
.footer-brand .brand-name .subword{color:var(--muted-2);}
.footer-brand p{color:var(--muted-2); font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.75; max-width:280px; margin-top:16px;}
.footer-col h4{color:var(--white); font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:20px; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif; font-weight:800;}
.footer-col ul li{margin-bottom:12px;}
.footer-col a{color:var(--muted-2); font-size:13.5px; transition:color .2s;}
.footer-col a:hover{color:var(--brass-light);}
.footer-contact li{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; color:var(--muted-2); font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:14px;}
.footer-contact svg{width:16px; height:16px; stroke:var(--brass-light); flex:none; margin-top:2px;}
.social-row{display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:20px;}
.social-btn{
  width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  position:relative; transition:border-color .2s;
}
.social-btn svg{width:16px; height:16px; stroke:var(--paper-2);}
.social-btn:hover{border-color:var(--brass-light);}
.social-tooltip{
  position:absolute; bottom:48px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); background:var(--white); color:var(--ink);
  font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; padding:6px 10px; white-space:nowrap; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .2s;
}
.social-btn:hover .social-tooltip{opacity:1;}
.bottom-bar{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:26px 0; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px;}
.bottom-bar p{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted-2);}
.legal-links{display:flex; gap:20px;}
.legal-links a{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted-2);}
.legal-links a:hover{color:var(--brass-light);}

/* ---------- floating whatsapp/phone ---------- */
.float-call{
  position:fixed; bottom:24px; right:24px; z-index:70; background:var(--leather); color:var(--white);
  width:56px; height:56px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft); transition:transform .2s;
}
.float-call:hover{transform:scale(1.08);}
.float-call svg{width:24px; height:24px;}

/* ---------- toast ---------- */
.toast{
  position:fixed; bottom:24px; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,20px); background:var(--ink); color:var(--white);
  padding:13px 22px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; border-radius:2px; z-index:120; opacity:0; transition:all .3s;
  pointer-events:none; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
}
.toast.show{opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0);}
.toast svg{width:16px; height:16px; stroke:var(--ok);}
</style>
</head>

<section class="about" id="historia">

    <div class="about-img">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mochila Estelios de piel artesanal">
      <div class="about-tag"><span class="num">2020</span><span class="cap">Origen</span></div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <span class="section-eyebrow">Nuestra historia</span>
      <h2>Una marca forjada con años de oficio marroquinero.</h2>
      <p>Espartanos Traditio nace en 2020 para ofrecer marroquinería artesanal de alto estándar en maletines, mochilas y portadocumentos, además del resto de nuestra colección. Detrás de cada pieza hay un equipo forjado a lo largo de años de experiencia en el sector.</p>
      <p>Trabajamos con pieles naturales y auténticas: garantizar la calidad es un reto constante que asumimos con el mismo esfuerzo, cuidando cada detalle para que nuestros productos sean una herramienta de trabajo verdaderamente efectiva.</p>
      <div class="about-badges">
        <span class="made-badge">MADE<span>SPAIN</span></span>
        <span class="leather-badge">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M12 2c4 3 8 6 8 11a8 8 0 0 1-16 0c0-5 4-8 8-11z"/></svg>
          100% Piel Real
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

  </section>

<!-- ===================== CART DRAWER ===================== -->
<div class="overlay" id="overlay"></div>
<aside class="drawer" id="cartDrawer">
  <div class="drawer-head">
    <h3>Tu carrito</h3>
    <button class="close-btn" id="closeCart"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0f1526" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
  </div>
  <div class="drawer-body" id="cartBody"></div>
  <div class="drawer-foot">
    <div class="subtotal-row">
      <span class="lbl">Subtotal</span>
      <span class="val mono" id="cartSubtotal">€ 0,00</span>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary btn-block" id="checkoutBtn">Finalizar compra</button>
    <p class="foot-note">Los gastos de envío se calculan en el siguiente paso.</p>
  </div>
</aside>

<!-- ===================== CHECKOUT MODAL ===================== -->
<div class="modal-wrap" id="checkoutModal">
  <div class="modal-box">
    <div class="modal-head">
      <h3 id="modalTitle">Datos de envío</h3>
      <button class="close-btn" id="closeModal"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0f1526" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
    </div>
    <div class="steps-track">
      <div class="step-dot"><i id="dot1"></i></div>
      <div class="step-dot"><i id="dot2"></i></div>
      <div class="step-dot"><i id="dot3"></i></div>
    </div>

    <div class="modal-body">

      <!-- STEP 1: SHIPPING -->
      <form id="stepShipping">
        <div class="form-row">
          <div class="field"><label>Nombre</label><input type="text" required placeholder="Nombre"></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Apellidos</label><input type="text" required placeholder="Apellidos"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
          <div class="field"><label>Email</label><input type="email" required placeholder="tucorreo@ejemplo.com"></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Teléfono</label><input type="tel" required placeholder="+34 600 00 00 00"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row single">
          <div class="field"><label>Dirección</label><input type="text" required placeholder="Calle, número, piso"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
          <div class="field"><label>Ciudad</label><input type="text" required placeholder="Ciudad"></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Código postal</label><input type="text" required placeholder="00000"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row single">
          <div class="field"><label>Notas del pedido (opcional)</label><textarea placeholder="Instrucciones de entrega..."></textarea></div>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-block">Continuar al pago</button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <!-- STEP 2: PAYMENT -->
      <form id="stepPayment" style="display:none;">
        <div class="order-summary" id="orderSummary"></div>

        <div class="pay-methods">
          <label><input type="radio" name="paym" value="card" checked><span>💳 Tarjeta</span></label>
          <label><input type="radio" name="paym" value="paypal"><span>PayPal</span></label>
          <label><input type="radio" name="paym" value="transfer"><span>Transferencia</span></label>
        </div>

        <div class="form-row single">
          <div class="field"><label>Nombre en la tarjeta</label><input type="text" id="cardName" required placeholder="Como aparece en la tarjeta"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row single">
          <div class="field"><label>Número de tarjeta</label><input type="text" id="cardNumber" required placeholder="0000 0000 0000 0000" maxlength="19"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
          <div class="field"><label>Caducidad</label><input type="text" id="cardExpiry" required placeholder="MM/AA" maxlength="5"></div>
          <div class="field"><label>CVC</label><input type="text" id="cardCvc" required placeholder="123" maxlength="4"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="demo-note">
          <strong>Modo demostración:</strong> esta pasarela de pago es una simulación visual para presentar la tienda. Ningún dato de tarjeta se envía ni se procesa. Para cobrar pedidos reales, conecta un proveedor como Stripe, Redsys o PayPal Checkout.
        </div>

        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-dark" id="backToShipping" style="flex:0 0 auto; padding-left:20px; padding-right:20px;">Atrás</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-block" id="payBtn">Confirmar y pagar</button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <!-- STEP 3: CONFIRMATION -->
      <div id="stepConfirm" style="display:none;" class="confirm-view">
        <div class="confirm-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>
        </div>
        <h3>¡Pedido recibido!</h3>
        <p>Gracias por tu compra. Te enviaremos la confirmación por correo. Si tienes cualquier duda, escríbenos a info@espartanostraditio.com.</p>
        <div class="order-num mono" id="orderNumber">PEDIDO #000000</div>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button class="btn btn-primary btn-block" id="closeConfirm">Volver a la tienda</button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>
  <span id="toastMsg">Añadido al carrito</span>
</div>

<script>window.__IMG_DATA__ = {"tirantes-etp306.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-06.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "mochila-estelios.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-05.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-04.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tirantes-etp301.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "maletin-gorgo.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "mochila-daxos.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-11.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "maletin-efialtes.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "porta-astinos.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tirantes-etp300.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-02.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tirantes-etp303.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tirantes-etp307.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tirantes-etp309.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tirantes-etp310.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "maletin-artemis.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-07.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "maletin-leonidas.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tirantes-etp304.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-01.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "maletin-jerjes.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-03.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-10.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "porta-dilios.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-08.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cinturon-09.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "bandolera-theron.jpg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};</script>
<script>
document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

/* =====================================================================
   NOTA PARA EL PROPIETARIO DE LA TIENDA
   - Los precios están marcados con price:0 (=> "Precio a consultar").
     Sustituye cada "price:0" por el precio real en euros, por ejemplo price:59.90
   - El enlace de Instagram está vacío (id="igBtn", href="#").
     Sustitúyelo por tu URL real cuando tengas la cuenta creada.
   - El checkout es una SIMULACIÓN. Para cobros reales integra Stripe,
     Redsys (TPV virtual español) o PayPal Checkout en el paso de pago.
===================================================================== */

const IMG = window.__IMG_DATA__ || {};

const PRODUCTS = [
  // ---------- CINTURONES ----------
  {id:'cin-01', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Automático Marrón', desc:'Hebilla de deslizamiento en acabado gunmetal sobre piel lisa color chocolate.', img:'cinturon-01.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-02', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Negro Clásico', desc:'Piel negra perforada con hebilla de aguja y grabado Espartanos.', img:'cinturon-02.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-03', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Automático Negro', desc:'Línea minimalista en piel negra con cierre de deslizamiento oculto.', img:'cinturon-03.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-04', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Hebilla Placa', desc:'Hebilla de placa maciza grabada, reversible marrón y negro.', img:'cinturon-04.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-05', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Azul Marino', desc:'Piel azul marino de grano fino con hebilla plateada de aguja.', img:'cinturon-05.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-06', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Negro Premium', desc:'Piel de grano fino en negro absoluto, corte sastre.', img:'cinturon-06.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-07', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Placa Espartanos', desc:'Hebilla de placa bruñida con logotipo grabado en relieve.', img:'cinturon-07.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-08', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Clásico Marino', desc:'Piel azul marino de grano marcado con hebilla plateada de aguja.', img:'cinturon-08.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-09', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Automático Elegance', desc:'Curva escultural en piel negra con cierre automático de placa.', img:'cinturon-09.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-10', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Reversible Negro', desc:'Dos looks en una pieza: negro mate por un lado, chocolate por el otro.', img:'cinturon-10.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'cin-11', cat:'cinturones', catLabel:'Cinturones', name:'Cinturón Reversible Azul', desc:'Reversible azul marino y burdeos con hebilla firmada Espartanos.', img:'cinturon-11.jpg', price:0},

  // ---------- MALETINES ----------
  {id:'mal-gorgo', cat:'maletines', catLabel:'Maletín', name:'Maletín Gorgo', desc:'Piel envejecida color cognac con bandolera y bolsillos frontales de cremallera.', img:'maletin-gorgo.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'mal-leonidas', cat:'maletines', catLabel:'Maletín', name:'Maletín Leonidas', desc:'Silueta limpia en piel malva, asa superior y cremallera panorámica.', img:'maletin-leonidas.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'mal-jerjes', cat:'maletines', catLabel:'Maletín', name:'Maletín Jerjes', desc:'Cartera clásica con solapa, cierre de gancho y bandolera desmontable.', img:'maletin-jerjes.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'mal-artemis', cat:'maletines', catLabel:'Maletín', name:'Maletín Artemis', desc:'Mensajero en piel rústica con bolsillo de cremallera superior.', img:'maletin-artemis.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'mal-efialtes', cat:'maletines', catLabel:'Maletín', name:'Maletín Efialtes', desc:'Doble hebilla frontal sobre piel de curtido natural.', img:'maletin-efialtes.jpg', price:0},

  // ---------- MOCHILAS Y BANDOLERAS ----------
  {id:'moc-estelios', cat:'mochilas', catLabel:'Mochila', name:'Mochila Estelios', desc:'Perfil redondeado, bolsillo frontal y asa de mano reforzada.', img:'mochila-estelios.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'moc-daxos', cat:'mochilas', catLabel:'Mochila', name:'Mochila Daxos', desc:'Líneas rectas y minimalistas pensadas para el día a día urbano.', img:'mochila-daxos.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'moc-theron', cat:'mochilas', catLabel:'Bandolera', name:'Bandolera Cruzada Theron', desc:'Formato compacto cruzado con cierre de mosquetón y correa ajustable.', img:'bandolera-theron.jpg', price:0},

  // ---------- PORTADOCUMENTOS ----------
  {id:'por-dilios', cat:'portadocumentos', catLabel:'Portadocumentos', name:'Portadocumentos Dilios', desc:'Funda tipo carpeta en piel lisa con cierre de cremallera perimetral.', img:'porta-dilios.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'por-astinos', cat:'portadocumentos', catLabel:'Portadocumentos', name:'Portadocumentos Astinos', desc:'Sobre de mano con correa desmontable y doble cremallera.', img:'porta-astinos.jpg', price:0},

  // ---------- TIRANTES ----------
  {id:'tir-304', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP304', name:'Tirantes ETP304', desc:'Diagonal negro jacquard con pajarita a juego incluida.', img:'tirantes-etp304.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'tir-303', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP303', name:'Tirantes ETP303', desc:'Estampado de rombos azul marino, con pajarita a juego.', img:'tirantes-etp303.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'tir-300', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP300', name:'Tirantes ETP300', desc:'Tono grafito liso con pajarita triangular a juego.', img:'tirantes-etp300.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'tir-309', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP309', name:'Tirantes ETP309', desc:'Micro-lunares sobre azul marino, con pajarita a juego.', img:'tirantes-etp309.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'tir-306', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP306', name:'Tirantes ETP306', desc:'Jacquard de rombos en negro, con pajarita a juego.', img:'tirantes-etp306.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'tir-310', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP310', name:'Tirantes ETP310', desc:'Gris perla liso, con pajarita a juego.', img:'tirantes-etp310.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'tir-307', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP307', name:'Tirantes ETP307', desc:'Rayas azul y blanco, con pajarita a juego.', img:'tirantes-etp307.jpg', price:0},
  {id:'tir-301', cat:'tirantes', catLabel:'ETP301', name:'Tirantes ETP301', desc:'Rayas marino y granate, con pajarita a juego.', img:'tirantes-etp301.jpg', price:0},
];

const money = v => v > 0
  ? '€ ' + v.toLocaleString('es-ES', {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2})
  : 'A consultar';

/* ---------------- RENDER CATALOG ---------------- */
const grids = {
  cinturones: document.getElementById('grid-cinturones'),
  maletines: document.getElementById('grid-maletines'),
  mochilas: document.getElementById('grid-mochilas'),
  portadocumentos: document.getElementById('grid-portadocumentos'),
  tirantes: document.getElementById('grid-tirantes'),
};

const qtyState = {};
PRODUCTS.forEach(p => qtyState[p.id] = 1);

function cardHTML(p){
  return `
  <article class="card" data-id="${p.id}">
    <div class="card-img">
      <span class="card-badge">${p.catLabel}</span>
      <img src="${IMG[p.img]}" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy">
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
      <h3 class="card-name">${p.name}</h3>
      <p class="card-desc">${p.desc}</p>
      <div class="card-meta"><span>Piel 100% Real</span></div>
      <div class="card-foot">
        <div class="price">${money(p.price)}<small>PVP</small></div>
        <div class="qty-add">
          <div class="qty-stepper">
            <button type="button" class="qminus" aria-label="Restar">−</button>
            <span class="qval">1</span>
            <button type="button" class="qplus" aria-label="Sumar">+</button>
          </div>
          <button class="add-btn" aria-label="Añadir al carrito">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>`;
}

PRODUCTS.forEach(p => { grids[p.cat].insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', cardHTML(p)); });

/* qty steppers + add to cart (event delegation) */
document.querySelectorAll('.grid').forEach(grid=>{
  grid.addEventListener('click', e=>{
    const card = e.target.closest('.card');
    if(!card) return;
    const id = card.dataset.id;
    if(e.target.closest('.qminus')){
      qtyState[id] = Math.max(1, qtyState[id]-1);
      card.querySelector('.qval').textContent = qtyState[id];
    }
    if(e.target.closest('.qplus')){
      qtyState[id] = Math.min(20, qtyState[id]+1);
      card.querySelector('.qval').textContent = qtyState[id];
    }
    const addBtn = e.target.closest('.add-btn');
    if(addBtn){
      addToCart(id, qtyState[id]);
      addBtn.classList.add('added');
      setTimeout(()=>addBtn.classList.remove('added'), 900);
      qtyState[id] = 1;
      card.querySelector('.qval').textContent = 1;
    }
  });
});

/* reveal-on-scroll for cards */
const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(en=>{ if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
},{threshold:0.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c=>io.observe(c));

/* ---------------- CART STATE (in-memory) ---------------- */
let CART = [];

function addToCart(id, qty){
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===id);
  const existing = CART.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(existing){ existing.qty += qty; } else { CART.push({...p, qty}); }
  renderCart();
  showToast(`${p.name} añadido al carrito`);
}

function removeFromCart(id){
  CART = CART.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
  renderCart();
}

function changeCartQty(id, delta){
  const item = CART.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!item) return;
  item.qty += delta;
  if(item.qty <= 0){ removeFromCart(id); } else { renderCart(); }
}

function cartTotal(){
  return CART.reduce((sum,i)=> sum + (i.price>0 ? i.price*i.qty : 0), 0);
}
function hasUnpriced(){
  return CART.some(i=>i.price<=0);
}

function renderCart(){
  const body = document.getElementById('cartBody');
  const count = CART.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty,0);
  document.getElementById('cartCount').textContent = count;

  if(CART.length===0){
    body.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-cart">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="9" cy="21" r="1"/><circle cx="20" cy="21" r="1"/><path d="M1 1h4l2.68 13.39a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.61h9.72a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.61L23 6H6"/></svg>
      <p>Tu carrito está vacío.<br>Explora la colección y añade tus piezas favoritas.</p>
    </div>`;
  } else {
    body.innerHTML = CART.map(i=>`
      <div class="cart-item" data-id="${i.id}">
        <img src="${IMG[i.img]}" alt="${i.name}">
        <div class="cart-item-info">
          <span class="nm">${i.name}</span>
          <span class="pr">${money(i.price)}${i.price>0?` · ${i.qty} ud.`:''}</span>
          <div class="cart-item-row">
            <div class="qty-stepper">
              <button type="button" class="cm">−</button>
              <span class="mono">${i.qty}</span>
              <button type="button" class="cp">+</button>
            </div>
            <button class="rm-btn">Eliminar</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');
  }
  document.getElementById('cartSubtotal').textContent = hasUnpriced() && cartTotal()===0
    ? 'A consultar'
    : money(cartTotal()) + (hasUnpriced() ? ' +' : '');
}

document.getElementById('cartBody').addEventListener('click', e=>{
  const row = e.target.closest('.cart-item');
  if(!row) return;
  const id = row.dataset.id;
  if(e.target.closest('.cm')) changeCartQty(id, -1);
  if(e.target.closest('.cp')) changeCartQty(id, 1);
  if(e.target.closest('.rm-btn')) removeFromCart(id);
});

/* ---------------- DRAWER OPEN/CLOSE ---------------- */
const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
const drawer = document.getElementById('cartDrawer');
function openCart(){ drawer.classList.add('show'); overlay.classList.add('show'); }
function closeCartFn(){ drawer.classList.remove('show'); overlay.classList.remove('show'); }
document.getElementById('cartBtn').addEventListener('click', openCart);
document.getElementById('closeCart').addEventListener('click', closeCartFn);
document.getElementById('footerCartLink').addEventListener('click', e=>{ e.preventDefault(); openCart(); });
overlay.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeCartFn(); closeModal(); });

/* ---------------- MOBILE NAV ---------------- */
const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
document.getElementById('burgerBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=> mobileNav.classList.toggle('open'));
mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click', ()=> mobileNav.classList.remove('open')));

/* ---------------- CHECKOUT MODAL ---------------- */
const modal = document.getElementById('checkoutModal');
const dots = [document.getElementById('dot1'), document.getElementById('dot2'), document.getElementById('dot3')];
const titles = ['Datos de envío', 'Pago', 'Confirmación'];

function openModal(){
  if(CART.length===0){ showToast('Tu carrito está vacío'); return; }
  modal.classList.add('show'); overlay.classList.add('show');
  closeCartFn();
  goStep(1);
}
function closeModal(){ modal.classList.remove('show'); overlay.classList.remove('show'); }

function goStep(n){
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = titles[n-1];
  dots.forEach((d,i)=> d.querySelector('i').style.width = (i < n ? '100%' : '0%'));
  document.getElementById('stepShipping').style.display = n===1 ? 'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('stepPayment').style.display = n===2 ? 'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('stepConfirm').style.display = n===3 ? 'block':'none';
  if(n===2){ renderOrderSummary(); }
}

function renderOrderSummary(){
  const box = document.getElementById('orderSummary');
  box.innerHTML = CART.map(i=>`<div class="row"><span>${i.qty} × ${i.name}</span><span>${i.price>0?money(i.price*i.qty):'A consultar'}</span></div>`).join('')
    + `<div class="row total"><span>Total</span><span>${hasUnpriced() ? money(cartTotal())+' + a confirmar' : money(cartTotal())}</span></div>`;
}

document.getElementById('checkoutBtn').addEventListener('click', openModal);
document.getElementById('closeModal').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
document.getElementById('stepShipping').addEventListener('submit', e=>{ e.preventDefault(); goStep(2); });
document.getElementById('backToShipping').addEventListener('click', ()=> goStep(1));

document.getElementById('closeConfirm').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  closeModal();
  CART = [];
  renderCart();
});

/* card number / expiry formatting */
const cardNumber = document.getElementById('cardNumber');
cardNumber.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
  let v = cardNumber.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,16);
  cardNumber.value = v.replace(/(.{4})/g,'$1 ').trim();
});
const cardExpiry = document.getElementById('cardExpiry');
cardExpiry.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
  let v = cardExpiry.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,4);
  if(v.length>=3) v = v.slice(0,2)+'/'+v.slice(2);
  cardExpiry.value = v;
});
document.getElementById('cardCvc').addEventListener('input', function(){
  this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,4);
});

document.getElementById('stepPayment').addEventListener('submit', e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const payBtn = document.getElementById('payBtn');
  const original = payBtn.innerHTML;
  payBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>';
  payBtn.disabled = true;
  setTimeout(()=>{
    payBtn.innerHTML = original;
    payBtn.disabled = false;
    const orderNum = 'ESP-' + Math.floor(100000 + Math.random()*899999);
    document.getElementById('orderNumber').textContent = 'PEDIDO #' + orderNum;
    goStep(3);
  }, 1400);
});

/* ---------------- INSTAGRAM PLACEHOLDER ---------------- */
document.getElementById('igBtn').addEventListener('click', e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  showToast('Próximamente en Instagram');
});

/* ---------------- TOAST ---------------- */
let toastTimer;
function showToast(msg){
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  document.getElementById('toastMsg').textContent = msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(()=> t.classList.remove('show'), 2400);
}

/* ---------------- ACTIVE CHIP ON SCROLL ---------------- */
const sections = ['cinturones','maletines','mochilas','portadocumentos','tirantes'].map(id=>document.getElementById(id));
const chips = document.querySelectorAll('.chip');
const chipObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(en=>{
    if(en.isIntersecting){
      chips.forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('active'));
      const match = document.querySelector(`.chip[href="#${en.target.id}"]`);
      if(match) match.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
},{rootMargin:'-40% 0px -50% 0px'});
sections.forEach(s=>chipObserver.observe(s));

renderCart();
</script>
</body>
</html>
